source_reference.interpretation: LAST_LEVEL and MAX_MIP both encode log2(stored fragments); texture descriptors do not independently encode coverage samples.

implementation.native_option: SpirvTarget.groupedMsaaMaxSamples defaults to 0, preserving native resource representation. 4 selects grouped sampled images.
implementation.descriptor_counts: imageLogicalSamples[i] is the stored fragment/sample-index count; imageNativeSamples[i] is 0 for native layout, otherwise 2 or 4 for grouped sampled-image array.
implementation.mapping: host layer = logical layer * (logicalSamples/nativeSamples) + sample/nativeSamples; host sample = sample%nativeSamples
implementation.query: OpImageQuerySize returns host array layers; logical arrays divide the returned layer count by groups. MSAA mip count returned by IMAGE_GET_RESINFO is 1.
representation_keys: resource specialization logical and native sample counts
disk compile key logical and native sample counts
implementation.required_capability: ImageMSArray, checked against enabled target capabilities before emitting the MS array type

covered_shader_forms: 2D MSAA array load and logical dimensions
verification.independent_emitted_arithmetic_check: Actual emitted integer arithmetic is evaluated independently; each fixture matches expected host layer and native sample.
verification.sanitizers: ASan and UBSan cover the focused decoder and fixture translation units; production recompiler is built Release, without full sanitizer instrumentation. STL container annotations disabled at the mixed instrumentation boundary.
verification.public_fixtures: Own synthetic descriptors and IR, no captured game shaders.
verification.patch_round_trip: applied from exact per-file baseline, byte-compared all 18 modified or added production files, reversed and verified exact restoration

shader_cache_guard_review.classification: Pure decoder of descriptor dwords word3 and word5; no mutable global state, environment changes or shader-compiler configuration writes.
shader_cache_guard_review.source_invalidation: GroupedMsaa.hpp is in the recompiler source glob hashed by ShaderCacheVersion.cmake.
shader_cache_guard_review.reason: Compiler use decodes descriptor-derived sample counts into the already-keyed resource specialization. GuestTextureResource use only validates and decodes host texture metadata.
shader_cache_guard_review.validation: Production ShaderCacheVersion.cmake run against the full HLE guard manifest with Windows paths normalized to this Mac. Original unreviewed manifest fails precisely on TextureFragmentCount; adding the reviewed name passes.
shader_cache_guard_review.native_routing_regression: Rerun passed: 28 production SPIR-V fixtures, 84 distinct addresses, 28 rejection cases; all emitted modules independently validated and evaluated.

guards: One-fragment grouped MSAA sampled image has no proved host representation and is refused.
Only R64KB_X color MSAA texture descriptors are admitted by the host decoder.
MSAA descriptor fragment-count fields must agree and remain within 1/2/4/8.
MSAA depth texture reads remain refused.
Compressed MSAA textures, nonzero minimum LOD and multi-layer guest MSAA arrays are refused by the host decoder.
MSAA shader storage writes, atomics, packed access, depth comparison, filtering, gather, and LOD query are refused.
limitations: The logical multi-layer address calculation is shader-tested; host guest arrays currently permit only one logical layer.
This checkpoint does not prove descriptor-to-host-view integration or any iPad GPU execution of the recompiled fixtures.
Solitaire rendering, full runtime library build, launch, audio and gameplay are not qualified by this evidence.
Grouped host texture resources and target option enablement belong to a separate integration checkpoint.
